1.

O Lord, when we reflect on How great Thy love is, We long to behold Thee And to be where Thou art.

2.

Yet though we walk here in the world As in a wilderness land, Where dangers we ever meet, Still Thy hand shields us.

3.

And in Thy love we find Such abundant consolation, That each day we must sing Thy praise with joyful voice.

4.

Our life, our light, our beloved Lord, Our rock and our rest! May every thought of Thee grant us Renewed consolation and faith.

5.

Our Saviour, ah, help us Thou To follow Thee faithfully here The little time, until we Thee May behold as Thou art.
